from_notes: Cabinet ministers should be in a 60:40 proportion between Andhra and Telangana.
from_notes_src: NextGen Modern AP History L2-12 p.4
x: The Gentlemen's Agreement (20 Feb 1956) fixed the Cabinet at 60:40 between Andhra and Telangana, not 3:1, so A is false. It also said that of the 40% Telangana ministers one would be a Muslim from Telangana, so R is true.
source: NextGen Modern AP History L2-12 p.4 (60:40 cabinet proportion); Rocket AP History p.44 (Gentlemen's Agreement, Feb 20, 1956); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gentlemen%27s_Agreement_of_1956 (search result: 'out of 40% of Telangana ministers, one will be a Muslim from Telangana')
evidence: Web search: Wikipedia / Telangana Today - one Muslim from Telangana among Telangana ministers

from_notes: PM-Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana: Ministry of Labour and Employment, implemented through EPFO; outlay ₹99,446 crore; 3.5 crore+ jobs.
x: The PM announced the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana in his 79th Independence Day speech (15 Aug 2025): an employment-linked incentive (₹99,446 crore) for first-time employees and employers, aiming at 3.5 crore jobs via EPFO. 'PM Kaushal Rozgar' and 'PM Awas Rozgar' are not schemes; PMRY was a 1993 self-employment scheme.
source: Praveen CA-360 Aug 2026 p.19 (PM-VBRY launched 1 Aug 2025, Ministry of Labour, one year); pib.gov.in/FactsheetDetails.aspx?Id=149240 (search result: announced on 79th Independence Day)

from_notes: 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹10 lakh for family income up to ₹8 lakh; collateral-free, guarantor-free
x: PM-Vidyalaxmi gives a 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹10 lakh to students with family income up to ₹8 lakh. The loans are collateral-free and guarantor-free, cover all courses at the 1,425 Quality HEIs, and include private institutions in the top 100 NIRF, so the other options are wrong.
source: PMF Lens Jun 2026 (13) p.3 (3% subvention, income up to ₹8 lakh, Quality HEIs); app notes 6:40 sub 5

x: Nannaya (11th century) is the Adikavi, the first poet of Telugu, and began the Andhra Mahabharatam under the Eastern Chalukya king Rajaraja Narendra. He was not one of Krishnadeva Raya's Ashtadiggajas, who lived in the 16th century, so A is true and R is false.
source: NextGen Eastern Chalukyas (nextgen-06) p.33 (Rajarajanarendra encouraged Nannaya); CDI AP History G2 PYQs 2000-2025 p.1 (Nannaya - Adi Kavi)

from_notes: Inscriptions indicate Rudramadevi ruled as 'Rudradeva Maharaja' in male form from 1258 AD onwards.
x: Rudramadevi (reign 1262-1289) is one of the most prominent Kakatiya rulers. Her inscriptions call her 'Rudradeva Maharaja', in the male form, which shows she was accepted as a full sovereign, so R explains A.
dispute: Printed key / question: from 1262 CE. Strictly, NextGen says the inscriptions use 'Rudradeva Maharaja' from 1258 AD, during her co-regency; her sole rule dates from 1262 (NextGen Kakatiyas p.51).
source: NextGen Kakatiyas (nextgen-08) p.9 (reign 1262-1289), p.51 ('Rudradeva Maharaja' from 1258); AP History APPSC 11 p.4 (same); printed key kept
evidence: AP History APPSC 11 p.4: 'Rudradeva Maharaja' from 1258 AD

x: NHAI was set up under the National Highways Authority of India Act, 1988, and books and CA magazines give 'established 1988'. It became operational only in February 1995, which is why 1995 tempts.
dispute: Most books and keys: 1988 (NHAI Act, 1988). Strictly: the authority was operationalised in February 1995 (general knowledge, not checked).
source: Praveen CA-360 Feb 2026 p.74 (NHAI established 1988, MoRTH); Praveen CA-360 May 2026 p.32 (NHAI: Established - 1988)
evidence: Praveen CA-360 Apr 2026 p.19, p.39: NHAI established 1988

x: 'Avail Online LPG Services' is the general portal (C); 'GiveItUp' is voluntarily surrendering the subsidy (D); 'Refill Booking and Online Payment' is booking plus paying (A); and 'Apply for New Connection' leaves the double-bottle connection (B). So 1-C, 2-D, 3-A, 4-B.
source: general knowledge, not checked (descriptions matched by their wording; National Government Services Portal service titles)

from_notes: Garbhini-GA2: first India-specific AI model to estimate the age of a foetus in the second and third trimesters; built under GARBH-INi (DBT) by IIT Madras and THSTI, Faridabad (February 2024)
x: Garbhini-GA2 is the first India-specific AI model that estimates foetal age in the second and third trimesters. It was built under GARBH-INi (DBT) by IIT Madras and THSTI, Faridabad, so both statements are correct.
source: PMF Lens Mar 2026 (02) p.62 (Garbhini-GA2: first indigenous AI model for fetal age, by IIT Madras and THSTI); app notes 6:41 sub 3

from_notes: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana: 100% centrally sponsored umbrella scheme (2021-22) for Scheduled Castes.
x: PM-AJAY (Anusuchit Jaati = Scheduled Castes) aims to reduce poverty in SC communities through skill development, income-generating schemes and infrastructure in SC-majority villages (Adarsh Gram). It is not for STs, hill communities or OBCs.
source: PMF Lens Jun 2026 (15) p.4, p.7 (PM-AJAY for SCs; villages with 40%+ SC population); app notes 6:41 sub 5
